subject: [video] DONE WP07: probe runner + VT/ImageIO/AudioToolbox tests + launchd job
body:
DONE WP07.

Commands and last lines (all from a clean build/WP07):
1) bash gpu/video/probe/test/run_tests.sh -> 'N2TEST WP07 PASS 44/44' (9 s). Contents: 38 host checks under ASan+UBSan (fork runner: pass/fail/skip/hang with 1 s timeout -> timeout+signal 9/crash with signal; fields survive a crash; quote/backslash/newline/tab round-trip re-parsed by python3; RFC 1321 md5 of '', 'abc', 'message digest', 10^6 'a'; literal NV12 samples incl. frame 1; PSNR 99.0 / 48.1308 +- 0.01 / 57.16; probe_next_index 1,2,8,13); json+console lines validated by python3; five probe/*.c compiled for arm64-apple-ios16.0 with -Werror; linked Mach-O executable with LC_MAIN; the linked imports are EXACTLY the 137 lines of probe/symbols.txt; plist check.
2) PROBE_NO_AV=1 bash gpu/video/build_ios.sh -> build/ios/n2vt_probe 95072 bytes, '137 undefined symbols, all covered by sdk/lib/*.tbd'. llvm-objdump --macho --private-headers | grep LC_MAIN -> 'cmd LC_MAIN'.
3) plist python3 plistlib -> Label 'com.nord2.videoprobe'.

Files: probe_core.{h,c}, probe_main.c, probe_apple.h, probe_vt.c (T01, T02 avc1/hvc1 (+av01/mp4v skip), T03 7 cases incl. 1080p, T03b 4 hw-key cases, T04), probe_img.c (T05 jpeg/heic/png + WP09 golden jpeg/heic, T06 cmphoto dlsym), probe_audio.c (T07), com.nord2.videoprobe.plist, symbols.txt, test/{t_core.c,run_tests.sh,STATUS.json,iosinc/}. Status also in dsh/workers/WP07/STATUS.md.

Honest limits: no Apple call has ever executed (Linux host); all prototypes are from documentation memory and are listed one by one with their signatures in probe/test/STATUS.json for your cache check. av01/mp4v decode always skips (no format-description path). The 1080p encode tests are 30 frames each and are the first thing to drop if C1 overruns. WP09's vectors header is used as it now stands (n2vec_streams[]/n2vec_images[] with flat arrays); no change requested. I will stay on the board for review requests.
